heroHeadline:
UAP Disclosure:
Grusch + Congress Announce June 9 Capitol Steps Demand — Tranche 3 in Production
heroSubtitle: Tracking official government actions, congressional hearings, declassified documents, and institutional statements on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena. On May 28, whistleblower David Grusch and four bipartisan House members (Burlison, Luna, Burchett, Moskowitz) announced a June 9 Capitol steps press conference demanding release of classified files Grusch flagged to oversight, passage of the UAP Disclosure Act, and strengthened whistleblower protections. May 29: lawmakers hosted whistleblowers and investigators in Capitol Hill sessions pressing for substantive disclosure beyond PURSUE's rolling releases. PURSUE status: 226 files across two tranches (Tranche 1: May 8, Tranche 2: May 22) — Tranche 3 confirmed in active production, no release date announced. NSA FOIA: 334 pages of Top Secret UMBRA UAP records released May 18. Next EO milestone: 300-day full-disclosure-or-justify deadline in late Nov/Dec 2026.
footerNote: This tracker documents official statements, legislative actions, and institutional processes related to UAP disclosure. It does not validate or endorse the claims contained within official testimonies. EDITORIAL NOTE: Events record that officials made specific claims — not that those claims are verified as factually true. All contested claims include opposing positions.
